body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Avermedia introduced HomeFree Duet at CES 2011.

HomeFree Duet is a LAN network TV Tuner device that allows users to watch real-time digital TV programs on iPad/laptop/desktop via home network. Its twin digital tuner design can serve two users to watch different TV channels on their own devices at the same time
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
